tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_1: Forged from a shard lost in the ancient flood of code,
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_2: its blade has no edge, yet is carved with flowing garbled runes.
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_3: This sword carries two mutually exclusive laws at once:
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_4: Overwrite - forcibly rewrite the target's low-level attributes in the "world system".
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_6: are all overwritten with the values the sword master defines the moment the blade touches.
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_7: Unset - one extra strike that harms no body, only erases the target's "definition".
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_8: You are not weakened, sealed, or defeated;
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_9: you simply become an "undefined entry" the system cannot recognize,
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_10: and unable to process you, the system ignores, forgets, and zeroes you out.
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_11: The enemy's discipline, gear and buffs, before Overwrite,
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_12: are just a line of text that Ctrl+C can replace;
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_13: the trump card the enemy prides itself on loses even the right to be remembered after Unset.
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_14: Your opponent is not fighting a swordsman,
tooltip.kunjinkao.kun_jin_kao.line_15: but a madman holding permission to edit the world's source code.
